transport: In-process Python, one serialized checker per bound scene and policy

create.signature: IncrementalRoutes(baseline, fixed, build, settings, source_widths, *, checking_headroom_mm=0.0, resume=False, prepare_single_route=False)
bindings: complete source route identities and original cores
active owner, topology and pin policies
create.resume: Use only in the owning continuation after authenticating the checkpoint and ledger and restoring accepted geometry and witnesses through the existing path.

requires: next eligible rung from the owning ladder
source-preserving candidate built from the bound original geometry
all inputs remain owned by the serialized checker
evaluate.effects: Runs the existing proposal predicates and returns the existing report shape. Accepted proof state stays unchanged until accept. The next evaluation clears the pending proposal.

accept.requires: The same route and factor passed the most recent evaluation in this checker
accept.effects: Publish the checked geometry, factor, rows and accepted proof chain together.

record.owner: The calling ladder or bounded benchmark retains the report and associates it with its scheduled attempt.

preparation.eligible_path: Checker-owned T04 CandidateSnapshot with one proposal and a restored or previously verified primitive dependency proof state
preparation.accepted_geometry: Checker-owned geometry map with a passing witness per route, keyed by source identity and exact candidate digest
preparation.spatial_view: Reuse the ordered maximum-envelope STRtree and copy its accepted bounds with one row replaced when the trial fits
preparation.affected_routes: Query both the accepted and trial spatial views with the existing construction guard, retaining deterministic query order

dependency_invalidation.same_accepted_state: Compare the prior trial route and the new trial route against the accepted versions
dependency_invalidation.prior_trial_accepted: Compare the new trial route against the just-accepted version
dependency_invalidation.unrelated_or_restored_state: Clear active dependency links and rebind to the restored state. Exact cached witnesses still require a full matching operand context.

fallbacks.trial_outside_prepared_envelope: Existing spatial index construction, including exact STRtree fallback

preparation.storage: Transient only. Spatial views retain the existing three-view bound. The trial overlay and dependency state use the existing checker lifetime.

unchanged_contracts.report_and_checkpoint: Existing width-check reports, proof-chain encoding and PassState schema

unsupported: public CLI or MCP endpoint for this option
changing the search order or skipping scheduled proposals
standalone persistence of the one-route overlay
reuse of a rejected verdict as a new check

qualification.reference: Same schedule, exact archived reports and accepted proof-chain hashes for bounded saved cases
